name: Rhaetian Railway in the Albula / Bernina Landscapes
description: Two narrow-gauge mountain lines cross the Swiss Alps and dip into northern Italy, linking Alpine valleys that were once cut off. The 67 km Albula line, opened in 1904, threads through 42 tunnels and galleries and over 144 viaducts and bridges. The 61 km Bernina line climbs through glacier country, and both routes are served by the scenic Glacier Express and Bernina Express trains.
